sources.snippet: MeterMind: Industrial Gauge Reading with ERNIE-4.5-VL Fine-tuned LoRA adapter for reading analog industrial gauges from images. Model Description MeterMind is a fine-tuned version of ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B that accurately reads analog gauge values from photographs. It was trained on synthetic industrial gauge images and achieves near-human accuracy.
